crossRefs.note: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.
As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples…
I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;
But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before…

people.name: Matthew
people.line: Apostle, tax collector, author of the Gospel of Matthew.

translations.web: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.
translations.bsb: Then Levi hosted a great banquet for Jesus at his house. A large crowd of tax collectors was there, along with others who were eating with them.
translations.kjv: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
translations.asv: And Levi made him a great feast in his house: and there was a great multitude of publicans and of others that were sitting at meat with them.
